newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's CMN approves ADRs launch for home banks.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's CMN approves ADRs launch for home banks.

text.p: Brazil's National Monetary Council has given its approval to Brazilian banks launching American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) overseas, said the Central Bank's director of controls.
"This will be a form of adding value to Brazilian banks. If the ADRs succeed well, then this shows confidence in the Brazilian banking system," said Alkimar Moura.
The proposal will now be sent for approval to President Fernando Henrique Cardoso, he added.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
